from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
r=Path.cwd(); h=Path('/tmp/hoplite/workspace/runs/handoff/RAGEBOT_HANDOFF_V10')
p=r/'continuation/evidence/wave5/scope'; d=json.loads((p/'coverage.json').read_text()); e=json.loads((p/'static_evidence.json').read_text())
assert d['base_commit']=='3e5fd5f8f1ac3dadd635d19ed8b946ee2567fd3b'
for key,s in d['sources'].items():
 b=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',s['commit']+':'+s['path']]) if s['root']=='git' else ((r if s['root']=='repo' else h)/s['path']).read_bytes()
 assert len(b)==s['size'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==s['sha256'],key
ids={x['id'] for x in d['domains']}
assert len(ids)==len(d['domains'])==24
assert {x['goal_bullet'] for x in d['domains']}==set(range(8))
for x in d['domains']:
 assert x['sources'] and x['archival_navigation_anchors'] and x['unresolved'] and x['next_bounded_step'],x['id']
 assert set(x['sources'])<=d['sources'].keys(),x['id']
 assert set(x['dependencies_to_resolve'])<=ids,x['id']
assert e['clue_budget']['examined_types']==len(e['clues'])==2
assert e['source']==d['sources']['dll']
assert not d['original_language_established'] and not d['full_tasks_closed']
